messages:
harper: Hi team — new draft of the product launch post is in Drive (internal link). Need a rapid pass on four items by EOD: 1) single-line lead, 2) benchmark claim + short footnote, 3) hero & footer CTAs, 4) inbound routing matrix (NA vs EMEA). Low friction please. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ryan: On it. For the lead I have two tight options: A) 'Predictable LLM inference, engineered for production' B) 'Reduce per-inference cost without compromising latency' — leaning A for clarity.

lucy: Legal quick-pass: benchmarks must include hardware, measurement window, and baseline definition. Avoid absolute guarantees. I suggest the bench copy: "as much as 3.5x lower per-inference cost in internal performance simulations (see methodology)." Add test dates and hardware in the footnote. Also replace any instances of "our tests" with "internal performance simulations."

harper: Thanks — numbers came from Dedicated alpha on A100x clusters, mixed-precision path, measured Mar 2026. I'll add that to the methodology link. Current draft used "up to 4x"  swapping to your suggestion Lucy.

omar: Growth ops: CTA set proposal
- Hero primary: "Request a technical demo"
- Hero secondary: "Attend launch webinar"
- Footer CTA: "Request trial access"
Proposed hero A/B: 75% demo / 25% webinar. Routing: demo -> SDR queue by region, webinar -> marketing nurture track, trial -> product ops. For EMEA route to EMEA SDR 08:00-18:00 CET; outside those hours fallback to NA SDR (09:00-17:00 ET).

harper: Pasting the demo routing CSV for ops handoff (owner emails included):
```
region,company_size,demo_type,owner_email,preferred_window
NA,SMB,Intro live demo,sd-na-01@redwood.com,09:00-11:00 ET
NA,Enterprise,Architecture deep-dive,sd-na-02@redwood.com,13:00-16:00 ET
EMEA,SMB,Recorded + scheduler,sd-emea-01@redwood.com,09:00-12:00 CET
EMEA,Enterprise,Live deep-dive,sd-emea-02@redwood.com,13:00-17:00 CET
APAC,Any,Recorded + local-calendar,sd-apac-01@redwood.com,Weekdays SGT
```

embargo-bot: Reminder: Embargo is active  DO NOT PUBLISH before 2026-04-08T17:00:00Z. Add metadata `embargo: true` to the post and remove public links until the embargo window. :lock:

lucy: Legal approves the adjusted footnote wording provided the methodology doc includes sequence length distribution, batching configs, and baseline fp16 reference details. One micro-edit: use the phrase "internal performance simulations" everywhere for consistency.

omar: HubSpot ops confirmed mapping. I'll push nurture tags and SDR queue IDs into the doc by 15:30 PT, and wire the CTA A/B split. Also recommend a fallback calendar link for APAC demo requests.

harper: Plan: 1) lock lead to option A, 2) insert Lucy's bench wording + methodology metadata, 3) finalize CTAs & AB split (75/25), 4) handoff demo CSV to ops and request design for hero CTAs. Final pass by 17:00 UTC; if no blockers I'll set doc status to ready-for-design and tag stakeholders. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
